confirmed.text: Project goal: refactor SillyTavern into server-side brain + thin clients (web SPA admin surface + React Native mobile app).

Codebase base: ref/Luker (aggressive SillyTavern fork) — already has storage Engine/Repo layer (fs/sqlite/mysql/postgres), multi-device sync, server-side generation jobs + WS ticket delivery, CardApp in-card app system. Copied to apps/server (minus .git and android/ios/harmony/desktop shells).

The 'brain' (prompt assembly, world-info engine, regex pipeline, macros/STscript, instruct mode) currently lives entirely in the frontend (apps/server/public/scripts/, ~30k+ lines jQuery). Backend is storage + LLM proxy + secrets.
Human confirmed: brain moves fully server-side; no offline requirement since LLM API calls need network anyway ('全部上云').
Mobile app: React Native + Expo thin client. Advanced features stay web-only or hidden; heavy UIs get dedicated pages not mixed into chat.

'重UI' = card-embedded HTML apps (inventory/quest/status panels, 状态栏, CardApp in Luker terms). Mobile hosts them in a dedicated bottom-nav '面板' page via react-native-webview sandbox + postMessage ctx bridge.
World book / card import-export compatibility is a hard requirement; mechanism = golden-diff corpus tests (original ST engine output vs @utopinn/core output on real cards).
Third-party frontend extensions (public/scripts/extensions/third-party) will NOT be compatible; accepted.
Local on-device storage of cards/world books is dropped as a v1 requirement; mobile keeps read cache + file import/export only.
